'''Savion Amhara''' was one of the three famous [[First Counsel]]s in [[Far Madding]].

==History== 
There is a statue of Savion Amhara in the market named after her, the Amhara Market. Her statue points towards the [[Tear]] Gate.{{ref/book|9|22}}
